title: XXL-JOB Executor Unauthenticated RCE
description: XXL-JOB 2.2.0 with no accessToken configured: the executor's /run endpoint on port 9999 accepts a job from anyone, and a GLUE_SHELL job runs its script on the executor host.
question: Abuse the unauthenticated XXL-JOB executor to run commands on it and read /ctf/flag.
